name: Daniel Mercer
bio: I have seven years of experience in finance, including work at major firms and in consulting, and hold a master’s degree in economics. I investigate private and public companies, ownership and capital, and how emerging technologies are reshaping businesses and careers.
about: I’m Daniel Mercer. I have seven years of experience in finance, including work at major firms and in consulting, and hold a master’s degree in economics. I maintain Visionary Talks as a research tool for a new and exciting business world.
interest: I love investigating private and public companies: who owns them, how they make money, and what their decisions mean for people’s careers. I’m particularly interested in AI and the forces shaping the future of business.
privacy: I still work in the finance industry. To protect my professional privacy, I write under the pen name Daniel Mercer rather than disclose my real name.
purpose: I built this space to turn curiosity into evidence. I follow company records, financial disclosures and the people behind businesses to understand what is changing—and why it matters.

research.title: Start with the records.
research.text: I conduct independent research into company announcements, filings, public datasets and archival records. I trace the original document and check the date and the claim it actually supports.

research.title: Show how the numbers work.
research.text: I distinguish company valuations, revenue, compensation and personal wealth. I identify third-party estimates and show the inputs and assumptions behind my own calculations.

research.title: Keep the unknowns visible.
research.text: I explain the limits of the available evidence, link sources naturally within the reporting, and revisit conclusions when the underlying records change.

corrections: If you spot an error, send me the article link, the claim in question and any supporting evidence. I review correction requests against the source records and update the article when a correction is warranted.
